notes_for_editor: Thin record: three listings only. The FFLA marks it gone; the Weebly list gives name and county with no date; the place-name guide only gives the hamlet. A search summary said a 100-foot Aermotor tower was erected at Independence in 1933, but on the Weebly page that entry sits under Mirror Lake, so it is not used. Another search lead (a 1936 steel tower under 'Remer #2' on a St. Louis County history site) was not verified and is not attributed to Independence. No builder, height, staffing, fires, photos, or site description found. Worth a check against Minnesota DNR or St. Louis County Historical Society records.
